default.headline: Our range for this job: $1,249 to $2,599
default.explain: For a 50-gallon gas tank at U.S. average prices with 1 extra ticked, we estimate $1,809 installed. Type the total on your quote to see where it falls, and add the line items if the quote lists them.
default.formula:
Our estimate = unit + labor × 1.000 (state price factor) + each ticked extra × 1.000

crossChecks.label: 50-gal gas tank, like-for-like, U.S. average (same cost model)
crossChecks.published: DOE average installed cost $1,432 (2022 dollars, baseline gas storage)
crossChecks.why: Ours is in today’s listing prices; DOE’s is 2022 dollars and averages all sizes from 20 to 55 gallons. PHCC told DOE its RSMeans-based installation costs are too low.
crossChecks.source: U.S. Department of Energy, Federal Register: Energy conservation standards for consumer water heaters, final rule (89 FR 37778, May 6, 2024)

crossChecks.label: 50-gal electric tank, like-for-like, U.S. average (same cost model)
crossChecks.published: DOE average installed cost $902 (2022 dollars, baseline electric storage)
crossChecks.why: The largest gap. DOE’s figure is 2022 dollars, includes smaller tanks and many new-construction installs; current 50-gallon listings alone are near $820.
crossChecks.source: U.S. Department of Energy, Federal Register: Energy conservation standards for consumer water heaters, final rule (89 FR 37778, May 6, 2024)

crossChecks.label: 50-gal heat pump, replacing an electric tank, U.S. average (same cost model)
crossChecks.published: DOE average installed cost $1,855 (2022 dollars, heat pump level)
crossChecks.why: DOE priced heat pump units from its own cost model for the 2030 market; today’s retail listings are higher. Space work for tight closets is an extra in both.
crossChecks.source: U.S. Department of Energy, Federal Register: Energy conservation standards for consumer water heaters, final rule (89 FR 37778, May 6, 2024)

tx-gas50.label: 50-gallon gas tank replacement in Texas, permit included
tx-gas50.headline: $2,400 is fair, on the high side
tx-gas50.explain: Your quote of $2,400 is 35% above our typical $1,782 for a 50-gallon gas tank in Texas. The price sits between our typical and high estimate. Ask what pushes it up: a longer warranty, a premium unit, or a hard install.

fl-el50.label: 50-gallon electric tank replacement in Florida, permit included
fl-el50.headline: $1,100 is fair, on the low side
fl-el50.explain: Your quote of $1,100 is 31% below our typical $1,605 for a 50-gallon electric tank in Florida. The price sits between our low and typical estimate for this job. Line items: installation labor at $300 is below our range ($310 to $931).

ca-hp50.label: 50-gallon heat pump replacing a gas tank in California (permit and new circuit)
ca-hp50.headline: $9,500 is far above our range
ca-hp50.explain: Your quote of $9,500 is 154% above our typical $3,735 for a 50-gallon heat pump in California. No extra in our cost model explains a price this high. Get at least two more written estimates before you sign.

checklist.text: Get written estimates from at least three contractors, and do not pick the lowest bid automatically; ask why the prices differ.
checklist.quote: Get written estimates from at least three contractors. Don't automatically choose the lowest bidder! Ask for explanations on price variations among proposals.
checklist.source: Virginia DPOR, Consumer Guide: Hiring a Contractor

checklist.text: Keep the deposit small: Virginia's consumer guide suggests no more than 10% or $1,000, whichever is less, unless the job needs special-order items.
checklist.quote: Consider an initial deposit of no more than 10% down or $1,000 , whichever is less.
checklist.source: Virginia DPOR, Consumer Guide: Hiring a Contractor

checklist.text: Never pay the full price up front, and hold the final payment until the work is done and has passed any required inspection.
checklist.quote: Never pay the full price up front ... Withhold final payment until the entire project is completed to your satisfaction and all required inspections and certificates of occupancy are finalized.
checklist.source: New York State Attorney General, Hiring a home-improvement contractor

checklist.text: Get it in writing: the brand and model of the heater, the warranty, the permit, and every promise made out loud.
checklist.quote: The contract should include a timeline for work to be completed, a payment schedule, and specifics about the project — such as types or brands of materials.
checklist.source: New York State Attorney General, Hiring a home-improvement contractor

bands.label: Below our range
bands.advice: A low price is not a problem in itself, but check what is left out: the permit, haul-away of the old heater, code items, or the brand and warranty of the unit.
